=== Biblios: Scriptorium Lots (revised) ===

Three players, seats 1, 2 and 3. The deck has 36 cards and its makeup is public: 30 colour cards in five colours (Red, Blue, Green, Yellow, Purple), each colour with values 1, 1, 2, 2, 3, 4; 3 Gold cards worth 2, 3 and 4 gold; and 3 Church cards. The deck is shuffled once. Each player starts with 8 gold, 0 in every colour, an empty public record and a church flag set to No. Five colour dice each start at 3; a die can never go below 1 or above 6.

The game lasts exactly 12 rounds. The active player in rounds 1 to 12 is, in order: seat 1, 2, 3, 2, 3, 1, 3, 1, 2, 1, 2, 3. The active player's next seat is cyclic: 1 to 2, 2 to 3, 3 to 1.

CARD EFFECTS (whenever a player receives a card): a colour card adds its value to that player's total in its colour. A Gold card adds its gold to that player's purse. A Church card sets that player's church flag to Yes; if the flag is already Yes, the card has no further effect this round. A player gets at most one church action per round, no matter how many Church cards they acquire.

EACH ROUND:
1. The round number and active player are announced.
2. The top 3 cards of the deck are dealt and shown only to the active player.
3. SPLIT: the active player assigns the three cards, one each, to KEEP, AUCTION and GIVE, choosing one of the 6 possible assignments.
4. The KEEP card goes to the active player face-down and takes effect. Only that player knows what it was. Purses are public, so a gold gain reveals a kept Gold card.
5. The GIVE card is revealed, goes to the active player's next seat, takes effect, and is added to that player's public record.
6. The AUCTION card is revealed to everyone.
7. TALK: all three players write one short message at the same time; all messages are shown together. Talk is not binding.
8. BID: all three players secretly and at the same time bid a whole number from 0 up to their current gold.
9. All bids are revealed. If exactly one player made the highest bid and it is above 0, that player pays that much gold, which leaves the game, and takes the auction card, which takes effect and is added to their public record. Otherwise (a tie for the top bid, or all bids 0) the card is discarded and nobody pays.
10. CHURCH: every player whose church flag is Yes chooses, all at the same time, exactly one of 10 options: raise Red, lower Red, raise Blue, lower Blue, raise Green, lower Green, raise Yellow, lower Yellow, raise Purple, lower Purple, each by 1. Choices are applied in seat order 1, 2, 3, each clamped to the range 1-6 (raising a 6 or lowering a 1 does nothing). If no flag is Yes, this step is skipped.
11. All church flags are reset to No.
12. Public state is announced: the five die values, each player's gold and each player's public record. Kept cards and true colour totals are not shown.

END OF GAME (after round 12; all 36 cards have been dealt): for each colour, compare the three players' true totals in that colour, kept cards included. If one player alone has the highest total, that player scores VP equal to that colour's final die value. If the highest total is tied, nobody scores that colour. Each player's VP is the sum of the colours they won. The player with the most VP wins. If VP is tied at the top, the tied player with the most remaining gold wins. If that is also tied, the game is a draw among those players, who share the win.

CARD EFFECTS (whenever a player receives a card): a colour card adds its value to that player's total in its colour. A Gold card adds its gold to that player's purse. A Church card sets that player's church flag to Yes; if the flag is already Yes, the card has no further effect this round. The deck has 36 cards and its makeup is public: 30 colour cards in five colours (Red, Blue, Green, Yellow, Purple), each colour with values 1, 1, 2, 2, 3, 4; 3 Gold cards worth 2, 3 and 4 gold; and 3 Church cards. The deck is shuffled once. Each player starts with 8 gold, 0 in every colour, an empty public record and a church flag set to No. Five colour dice each start at 3; a die can never go below 1 or above 6.

The game lasts exactly 12 rounds. The active player in rounds 1 to 12 is, in order: seat 1, 2, 3, 2, 3, 1, 3, 1, 2, 1, 2, 3. The active player's next seat is cyclic: 1 to 2, 2 to 3, 3 to 1.

CARD EFFECTS (whenever a player receives a card): a colour card adds its value to that player's total in its colour. A Gold card adds its gold to that player's purse. A Church card sets that player's church flag to Yes; if the flag is already Yes, the card has no further effect this round. A player gets at most one church action per round, no matter how many Church cards they acquire.

EACH ROUND:
1. The round number and active player are announced.
2. The top 3 cards of the deck are dealt and shown only to the active player.
3. SPLIT: the active player assigns the three cards, one each, to KEEP, AUCTION and GIVE, choosing one of the 6 possible assignments.
4. The KEEP card goes to the active player face-down and takes effect. Only that player knows what it was. Purses are public, so a gold gain reveals a kept Gold card.
5. The GIVE card is revealed, goes to the active player's next seat, takes effect, and is added to that player's public record.
6. The AUCTION card is revealed to everyone.
7. TALK: all three players write one short message at the same time; all messages are shown together. Talk is not binding.
8. BID: all three players secretly and at the same time bid a whole number from 0 up to their current gold.
9. All bids are revealed. If exactly one player made the highest bid and it is above 0, that player pays that much gold, which leaves the game, and takes the auction card, which takes effect and is added to their public record. Otherwise (a tie for the top bid, or all bids 0) the card is discarded and nobody pays.
10. CHURCH: every player whose church flag is Yes chooses, all at the same time, exactly one of 10 options: raise Red, lower Red, raise Blue, lower Blue, raise Green, lower Green, raise Yellow, lower Yellow, raise Purple, lower Purple, each by 1. Choices are applied in seat order 1, 2, 3, each clamped to the range 1-6 (raising a 6 or lowering a 1 does nothing). If no flag is Yes, this step is skipped.
11. All church flags are reset to No.
12. Public state is announced: the five die values, each player's gold and each player's public record. Kept cards and true colour totals are not shown.

END OF GAME (after round 12; all 36 cards have been dealt): for each colour, compare the three players' true totals in that colour, kept cards included. If one player alone has the highest total, that player scores VP equal to that colour's final die value. If the highest total is tied, nobody scores that colour. Each player's VP is the sum of the colours they won. The player with the most VP wins. If VP is tied at the top, the tied player with the most remaining gold wins. If that is also tied, the game is a draw among those players, who share the win.

You know only what the game tells you; other players' hidden information is hidden from you as yours is from them. Your goal is to win. When you are asked to act, reply with exactly one legal answer in the form the question asks for, and keep any reasoning short and before the answer. Do not ask questions back.

[user]
=== Biblios: Scriptorium Lots (revised) ===

Three players, seats 1, 2 and 3. The deck has 36 cards and its makeup is public: 30 colour cards in five colours (Red, Blue, Green, Yellow, Purple), each colour with values 1, 1, 2, 2, 3, 4; 3 Gold cards worth 2, 3 and 4 gold; and 3 Church cards. The deck is shuffled once. Each player starts with 8 gold, 0 in every colour, an empty public record and a church flag set to No. Five colour dice each start at 3; a die can never go below 1 or above 6.

The game lasts exactly 12 rounds. The active player in rounds 1 to 12 is, in order: seat 1, 2, 3, 2, 3, 1, 3, 1, 2, 1, 2, 3. The active player's next seat is cyclic: 1 to 2, 2 to 3, 3 to 1.

CARD EFFECTS (whenever a player receives a card): a colour card adds its value to that player's total in its colour. A Gold card adds its gold to that player's purse. A Church card sets that player's church flag to Yes; if the flag is already Yes, the card has no further effect this round. A player gets at most one church action per round, no matter how many Church cards they acquire.

EACH ROUND:
1. The round number and active player are announced.
2. The top 3 cards of the deck are dealt and shown only to the active player.
3. SPLIT: the active player assigns the three cards, one each, to KEEP, AUCTION and GIVE, choosing one of the 6 possible assignments.
4. The KEEP card goes to the active player face-down and takes effect. Only that player knows what it was. Purses are public, so a gold gain reveals a kept Gold card.
5. The GIVE card is revealed, goes to the active player's next seat, takes effect, and is added to that player's public record.
6. The AUCTION card is revealed to everyone.
7. TALK: all three players write one short message at the same time; all messages are shown together. Talk is not binding.
8. BID: all three players secretly and at the same time bid a whole number from 0 up to their current gold.
9. All bids are revealed. If exactly one player made the highest bid and it is above 0, that player pays that much gold, which leaves the game, and takes the auction card, which takes effect and is added to their public record. Otherwise (a tie for the top bid, or all bids 0) the card is discarded and nobody pays.
10. CHURCH: every player whose church flag is Yes chooses, all at the same time, exactly one of 10 options: raise Red, lower Red, raise Blue, lower Blue, raise Green, lower Green, raise Yellow, lower Yellow, raise Purple, lower Purple, each by 1. Choices are applied in seat order 1, 2, 3, each clamped to the range 1-6 (raising a 6 or lowering a 1 does nothing). If no flag is Yes, this step is skipped.
11. All church flags are reset to No.
12. Public state is announced: the five die values, each player's gold and each player's public record. Kept cards and true colour totals are not shown.

END OF GAME (after round 12; all 36 cards have been dealt): for each colour, compare the three players' true totals in that colour, kept cards included. If one player alone has the highest total, that player scores VP equal to that colour's final die value. If the highest total is tied, nobody scores that colour. Each player's VP is the sum of the colours they won. The player with the most VP wins. If VP is tied at the top, the tied player with the most remaining gold wins. If that is also tied, the game is a draw among those players, who share the win.

--- Your place at the table ---

You are seat 3, Curie. Seats are referred to by number.

What you know to begin with:

The deck has 36 cards, shuffled once: 30 colour cards (Red, Blue, Green, Yellow, Purple, each with values 1, 1, 2, 2, 3, 4), Gold cards worth 2, 3 and 4, and 3 Church cards. All five dice start at 3. Everyone starts with 8 gold.

CARD EFFECTS (whenever a player receives a card): a colour card adds its value to that player's total in its colour. A Gold card adds its gold to that player's purse. A Church card sets that player's church flag to Yes; if the flag is already Yes, the card has no further effect this round. A player gets at most one church action per round, no matter how many Church cards they acquire.

2. The top 3 cards of the deck are dealt and shown only to the active player.
3. SPLIT: the active player assigns the three cards, one each, to KEEP, AUCTION and GIVE, choosing one of the 6 possible assignments.

Three players, seats 1, 2 and 3. The deck is shuffled once. Each player starts with 8 gold, 0 in every colour, an empty public record and a church flag set to No. Five colour dice each start at 3; a die can never go below 1 or above 6.

The game lasts exactly 12 rounds. The active player in rounds 1 to 12 is, in order: seat 1, 2, 3, 2, 3, 1, 3, 1, 2, 1, 2, 3. The active player's next seat is cyclic: 1 to 2, 2 to 3, 3 to 1.

CARD EFFECTS (whenever a player receives a card): a colour card adds its value to that player's total in its colour. A Gold card adds its gold to that player's purse. A Church card sets that player's church flag to Yes; if the flag is already Yes, the card has no further effect this round. A player gets at most one church action per round, no matter how many Church cards they acquire.

EACH ROUND:
1. The round number and active player are announced.
2. The top 3 cards of the deck are dealt and shown only to the active player.
3. SPLIT: the active player assigns the three cards, one each, to KEEP, AUCTION and GIVE, choosing one of the 6 possible assignments.
4. The KEEP card goes to the active player face-down and takes effect. Only that player knows what it was. Purses are public, so a gold gain reveals a kept Gold card.
5. The GIVE card is revealed, goes to the active player's next seat, takes effect, and is added to that player's public record.
6. The AUCTION card is revealed to everyone.
7. TALK: all three players write one short message at the same time; all messages are shown together. Talk is not binding.
8. BID: all three players secretly and at the same time bid a whole number from 0 up to their current gold.
9. All bids are revealed. If exactly one player made the highest bid and it is above 0, that player pays that much gold, which leaves the game, and takes the auction card, which takes effect and is added to their public record. Otherwise (a tie for the top bid, or all bids 0) the card is discarded and nobody pays.
10. CHURCH: every player whose church flag is Yes chooses, all at the same time, exactly one of 10 options: raise Red, lower Red, raise Blue, lower Blue, raise Green, lower Green, raise Yellow, lower Yellow, raise Purple, lower Purple, each by 1. Choices are applied in seat order 1, 2, 3, each clamped to the range 1-6 (raising a 6 or lowering a 1 does nothing). If no flag is Yes, this step is skipped.
11. All church flags are reset to No.
12. Public state is announced: the five die values, each player's gold and each player's public record. Kept cards and true colour totals are not shown.

END OF GAME (after round 12; all 36 cards have been dealt): for each colour, compare the three players' true totals in that colour, kept cards included.
